notes: Reader-only live fix. 0.8.6.17 proved neural audio works, but the watcher replayed stale [XAI_TTS] records from existing NWN logs when launched before the game, so it could start speaking immediately. Existing logs now begin at EOF on watcher startup; only fresh commands after pressing play are read. The reader UI is reduced again to a tiny fresh R window with only ASCII > (play) and X (stop), avoiding unsupported glyphs and the oversized 0.8.6.17 panel. Campaign lore extraction now checks all four GetDescription variants (current/original x identified/unidentified) and speaks the longest, with hidden BOOKDBG lengths/tag/resref copied into XANOS_READER_TTS.log for exact diagnosis if an official book still stores its visible body outside item descriptions. Exact opened-book object capture remains. No companion AI/combat/utility/dual-wield/familiar/core changes.
